implication: A Reg 31(4) disclosure (triggered at 25%+ aggregate shareholding) is the formal gate-opener for takeover obligations: acquirer must now assess whether open offer, independent director appointment, or regulatory clearance is required within 60 days.

framework.ref: SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011 — Regulation 31(4)
framework.note: Mandatory disclosure of substantial acquisition (≥25% or threshold-crossing) to stock exchange within 4 business days of acquisition.
Triggers open offer obligation if acquirer crosses 25% of voting capital; exemptions and acquisitions under specific clauses must be evaluated.
Open offer requirement (minimum 26% of voting capital at floor price) must commence within 60 days of disclosure if threshold crossed.
Related-party transaction disclosures if acquirer is connected; board approval / shareholder consent may be triggered.

framework.ref: Stock Exchange Listing Rules — Chapter 10 (substantial acquisition)
framework.note: Continuous disclosure and fair-play obligations during offer period; insider trading restrictions apply.
Acquirer and connected parties enter restricted period; trading in target shares prohibited without SEBI clearance.

framework.ref: Ministry of Corporate Affairs — DIN & PAN verification rules
framework.note: Acquirer identity and beneficial ownership must be verified; shell company flags trigger additional scrutiny.

headline: Laxmi Pat Bothra files substantial acquisition disclosure in EPACK Durable
sum: Laxmi Pat Bothra has filed a Regulation 31(4) disclosure under SEBI's Takeover Code, signalling a substantial acquisition in EPACK Durable Limited. The filing marks entry into the mandatory disclosure phase under takeover regulations.
detail: Laxmi Pat Bothra has submitted a Regulation 31(4) disclosure to NSE and BSE as per SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011. This disclosure is filed when a person acquires 25% or more of voting capital or when an acquirer's aggregate shareholding crosses defined thresholds. EPACK Durable Limited is an industrial packaging company. The disclosure initiates the mandatory offer timeline and triggers review of takeover conditions under the Code.

triggers.note: Mandatory disclosure when acquirer crosses 25% threshold or acquires shares at or above specified incremental limit.
Open offer must be made within 60 days of disclosure unless exemption applies (e.g., gifts, inheritance, court orders, inter se transfers).
Acquirer and connected persons subject to restricted period; no trading in target scrip without pre-clearance.
